one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform for funnels, email, and courses

evidence.claim: Public API authenticated with self-generated API keys from account Settings
evidence.quote: API keys are unique identifiers that authenticate requests to our Public API.

evidence.claim: API keys available on all plans, including the free tier
evidence.quote: You can now have up to 3 API keys per account! account, regardless of your plan!

evidence.claim: A free plan exists alongside paid plans
evidence.quote: Systeme.io Pricing — Free, Startup, Webinar, Unlimited Plans

evidence.claim: Broad API surface spanning contacts, newsletters, funnels, courses, communities, automation, and webhooks, with official reference docs
evidence.quote: Manage webhooks: Programmatically create new webhooks to receive real-time notifications, retrieve lists of your existing webhooks, and remove webhooks that are no longer needed.

evidence.claim: Vendor ships an official MCP server with its own documentation
evidence.quote: The new MCP server feature gives users, partners, and developers a powerful new way to interact with systeme.io using AI tools.

notes: Official MCP server documented at developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server; MCP scope currently limited to contacts/tags/custom fields, newsletters, opt-in funnels, price plans, coupons, and automation rules (no funnel edit/delete or newsletter delete via MCP). Max 3 API keys per account; keys are copyable only at creation and can have optional expiration. API reference lives at developer.systeme.io/reference/api.
